Third-party assets used by Dawaya
=================================

EG Drugs dataset
- File: ../egyptian-drugs.json
- Project: https://github.com/mahmoudfalous/eg-drugs
- License: MIT (see LICENSE-eg-drugs.txt)
- Copyright (c) 2026 Mahmoud Mohamed
- The bundled file keeps commercial name (English/Arabic), active ingredient,
  concentration, company, drug class, pack size and listed price. It is read
  from app-private storage; nothing is sent anywhere.
